# Profiler

# Profiling PHP Applications with SPX

Unfortunately, the [SPX PHP Extension](https://github.com/NoiseByNorthwest/php-spx) is not available for Windows and this feature is only available on macOS. If you are interested what macOS users can do with SPX, head over to [their docs](https://herd.laravel.com/docs/macos/debugging/profiler.md).
